lessonTitle: 50. Building right angles on the ground
lessonTitleEnglish: Building right angles on the ground
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: On the ground a right angle is built with an ecker: two perpendicular bars with sights at their ends.
stages.headlineEnglish: On the ground a right angle is built with an ecker: two perpendicular bars with sights at their ends.

stages.headline: Sight pole A through one pair of sights, then set pole B through the other pair; then ∠AOB = 90°.
stages.headlineEnglish: Sight pole A through one pair of sights, then set pole B through the other pair; then ∠AOB = 90°.

stages.headline: A right angle can also be made with a rope: a triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 equal parts is right-angled.
stages.headlineEnglish: A right angle can also be made with a rope: a triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 equal parts is right-angled.

stages.headline: What angle does an ecker set out?
